description: This file defines the Base64Attachment class, which is a validation rule for checking properties of base64-encoded attachments, including type, extension, size, and filename length, within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: Base64Attachment
classes.description: A validation rule class for checking base64-encoded file attachments, ensuring they meet specified type, extension, size, and filename length constraints.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input object to ensure it contains required fields, type and extension are allowed, filename length constraints are met, and the base64 decode matches the size limit.

methods.name: validateMin
methods.description: Checks if the filename length is above the minimum length constraint.

methods.name: validateMax
methods.description: Checks if the filename length is below the maximum length constraint.
